title: Helium Demand Could Rise From 100 To 190 By 2035
hook: Helium demand could climb to 190 by 2035.
closing: More demand against limited reserves means higher costs for everyone.
question: Where would helium shortages hurt most?

segments.say: Qatar holds 10.1 billion cubic meters, concentrating a major share of helium supply.
Projected helium demand reaches 190 by 2035, nearly doubling today's index.
The helium price index reached 400 in 2013, showing how quickly shortages hit buyers.
